title: proof_verify output (VerifyResult)
description: Verification result envelope (catalog shape `VerifyResult`; mirrors the `receipt_verify` tool result). Advertise-only per RCX Session-Handshake v1; the field set is open (additive).

verified.description: True when the receipt's hash chain and signature (if present) verify.

signer_passport.description: Signer key id or public-key fingerprint, when a signature was verified.

errors.description: Machine-readable verification error codes, e.g. `BODY_HASH_MISMATCH`. Empty when verified.

feature_enabled.description: False when the daemon's receipt-verify feature flag is off; verification was skipped.
